page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a running head at the top and a catchword at the bottom right. No margin notes. Order: running head with page number; opening paragraph (continued from previous page); centred title heading; list of provinces and cities in italic lines; catchword "Ciuitas" at bottom right.

main_text.p: Germanorum, quales & quot quisque sub se Episcopos, vel Metropoleon, quales sub se illo tempore ciuitates habuere, distributionem ex vetustissimo quodam Codice, qui anno Regni Caroli Magni XLII. Imperii autem IX. scriptus est, desumptam hic subiiceremus, quae ad hunc modum habet.
main_text.head: BREVIS ANNOTATIO DE CIVITATIBVS ET METROPOLEIS, VEL QVALES sub se habent ciuitates.

l.i: Prima Prouincia Lugdunensis habet ciuitates numero v.
Secunda Prouincia Lugdunensis habet ciuitates numero vii.
Tertia Prouincia Lugdunensis habet ciuitates numero viii.
Quarta Prouincia Lugdunensis habet ciuitates numero viii.
Prima Prouincia Belgica habet ciuitates numero iiii.
Secunda Prouincia Belgica habet ciuitates numero xii.

page.notes: Some words are damaged by a dark blotch near "Quarta Prouincia" and "Metropolis ciuitas Senones"; readings there are uncertain. "Ciuitas Ottiodoro" and "Ciuitas Medomatrix" are doubtful and may be misprinted. The catchword "Ciuitas" at the foot is printed at the bottom right.
